en: The *Rakṣākāla-kara-stava*:
Om, homage to the Lord of the World!
Whatever sins have been committed by me through the accumulations of body, speech, and mind—
O Protector, take all that away from me; protect me, O Leader of the World! || 1 ||
For twelve years in Nepal there has been a drought, a source of great terror;
having installed Narendradeva, protect me, O Leader of the World! (2)
In the realm of mortals and in the netherworld, worldly beings are full of suffering;
O Leader of the World, protect me and increase their happiness. (3)
Wherever you have gone, out of compassion for all sentient beings, you deliver them from their evils; protect me, O Leader of the World! (4)
Pervaded as I am within saṃsāra, how shall I reach the further shore?
You alone are my refuge there; protect me, O Leader of the World! (5)
For you consist of all the gods, and likewise you consist of all the Buddhas;
you consist of all spiritual accomplishments—protect me, O Leader of the World!
For you are always composed of compassion, and you are always composed of protection;
you are indeed always composed of wisdom—protect me, O Leader of the World!
By whomsoever a deed was done, by that very person it is sustained;
whatever you shall grant according to their wish, protect me, O Leader of the World! (8)
O Leader of the World, protect me in this pit of saṃsāra until all sentient beings have reached Sukhāvatī. 9.
To the wise you are the embodiment of knowledge; to the suffering you are the remover of pain; to those possessed by desire you take the form of their longing. O Leader of the World, protect me! 10.
O Lord of the World, you are worthy of worship, for you bear the very form of the Praṇava;
you are indeed always to be saluted—protect me, O Leader of the World! 11.
Whether he be a supporter or a detractor, a friend or even an enemy—endowed with compassion toward all, O Leader of the World, protect me. (12)
O Lord of the World, O Sovereign of the Universe, with a mind made full of sublime devotion, I bow to you again and yet again; protect me, O Leader of the World! (13)
I am a partaker of manifold sufferings through truly terrifying hardships and perils; have compassion, O Lord of Avalokita, and deliver me in an instant! 14.
Performing the perfect convergence of all sacrifices, make my merit inexhaustible;
may you have compassion for me and establish my devotion as immovable. || 15 ||
The hymn for the protection of the venerable Lord Śrīmad Āryāvalokiteśvara is completed.
